_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score-band coil with flat funding and grind momentum; base rate favors HOLD until F&G or flows break the band.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst HOLD/CAUTION coil vs narrative price-up vignette with no forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds ~47-62, funding near flat, 30d momentum remains grind, no vol spike or inflow flush
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks <39 with vol/inflows (down to Anxiety) or >62 with funding/momentum expansion (up toward Optimism)
